_readme: Channel guard. Empty chats map = NOTHING is guarded. Add one block per chat (copy from moderation.example.json). dry_run defaults to true; single-chat enable: jq '.chats["-1001234567890"].dry_run=false' configs/moderation.json > /tmp/m.json && mv /tmp/m.json configs/moderation.json -- no restart, the config hot-reloads on mtime. The bot must be an admin with delete_messages + restrict_members (+ ban when captcha_kick/propagation is on).
